title: Conversational Past Continuous (داشتم می‌رفتم)
summary: Expressing actions right in the middle of happening in past everyday speech.
explanation: Modern conversational Persian uses conjugated 'داشتن' right before a 'می-' past verb (e.g. داشتم می‌رفتم = I was just going).

example_translations.ex_dasht_1: I was on my way home when I saw him/her.

common_error_explanations.err_dasht_1: Conjugate both verbs with matching person endings.
